method: Privileged container pinned to one P-core. PAPI 7 and the bundled PAPI 5.5 report no PMU on this hybrid CPU (libpfm: no default PMU), so counts come from perf stat on cpu_core. Columns keep the PAPI names ingest expects: cycles, instructions, cycle_activity.stalls_total as PAPI_STL_ICY, mem_inst_retired loads+stores as PAPI_LST_INS, branch-instructions as PAPI_BR_INS, mem_load_retired l1/l2/l3 misses, and width-weighted fp_arith_inst_retired as SP/DP ops. Groups are separate runs and were checked to run at 100% (no multiplexing). Time, peak memory including child processes, and /proc/self/io come from an uninstrumented run. CPU time includes reaped children. Initial sample, not 30 repetitions.
